headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 14, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.73% compared to SPY's 14.57%. This results in an average alpha of 12.17%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 49.54%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 18.75%, which still reflects positive performance relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
